reviewSamples.author: John Cooke
reviewSamples.text: We couldn't be more pleased with Best Electric. They are professional, knowledgeable, reliable, and they give good advice and explain everything clearly. Their work is done efficiently and with attention to detail.

reviewSamples.author: Thom Reeves
reviewSamples.text: The 2 Best Electric gentlemen were on-time, efficient, friendly, knowledgeable and clean. They installed a 220V outlet for my Tesla charger and knew exactly how to do it. I'd recommend Best Electric to anyone. And Ruth, who took my call and helped set up the appointment, was very helpful. Thanks.

reviewSamples.author: Carol Lanham
reviewSamples.text: Best Electric lived up to their name. They put recessed lighting in my kitchen. It's wonderful to have light! And they left the kitchen pristine!

reviewSamples.author: Jeff Hoerle
reviewSamples.text: Best Electric is a wonderful and very responsive company. Carl is fantastic and provides great explanation of what he is doing and excellent work. We have relied on Best Electric for years!

reviewSamples.author: Mike Moriarty
reviewSamples.text: Karl was very professional, meticulous helpful, punctual and knowledgeable. He installed several light fixtures, smart switches and a replacement bathroom exhaust fan, concerning which he gave some great advanced recommendations.
